author: Kushal
problem: sent and delivered are timestamps like '2026-03-01 14:30' for when a parcel was handed to the courier and when it arrived. Return how many hours it spent in transit.
bug_description: Uses timedelta.seconds, which leaves out whole days, instead of total_seconds(), so parcels in transit for a day or more lose 24 hours per day.

comments.accurate: Returns the total time the parcel spent in transit, in hours
comments.wrong_behavior: Returns the hours in transit on top of any full days the parcel spent
comments.wrong_location: Elapsed-time conversion verified; fromisoformat may reject the space between date and time
